subject.title: Feature - Implement paid certificate or badge for a manual review and approval of skills

question: Should the reviewed-community path in https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2272 include a paid expedited queue, and what assurance may its artifact-level badge communicate?
rationale: Payment priority, attestation scope, neutral outcomes, expiry, revocation, appeals, refunds, reviewer authority, and liability are product and trust-policy choices that current code cannot determine.

options.title: Design narrow paid queue
options.body: Allow payment only for queue priority within a time-bounded, revocable review process whose outcome remains neutral.

options.title: Keep review unpaid
options.body: Define the vetted-community review path without payment or expedited access.

options.title: Decline human certification
options.body: Retain Official identity, provenance verification, moderation, and automated scans as the complete public trust model.

recommendation.title: Design narrow paid queue
recommendation.body: Allow payment only for queue priority within a time-bounded, revocable review process whose outcome remains neutral.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Official publisher, verification, source-sync, and abuse-control history makes this the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
